flags.title: Size it — don't fall in love
flags.note: Even a clean BUY deserves a position cap and an exit plan. Concentrated conviction (loyalty to one name) is how good theses become big drawdowns.
flags.lesson: Amazon: a great company held with no diversification became the biggest single loss.

opportunities.point: The company projected ₹70 crore in revenue in Year 1 from the capacity expansion.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "Projected ₹70 crore revenue in Year 1" (concall ppt - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Management expects a company-level CAGR of 15% to 20% over the next 3 to 5 years.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "Just a moment, sir, at least say 15 to 20% CAGR for next 3 to 5 years. We are expecting." (concall transcript - 2025-08-01)

opportunities.point: Unit 3 Phase 1 will cater to premium range excipient products and Phase 2 will cater to MCC.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Phase 1 will cater to, say, a premium range of excipient products, and Phase 2 will cater to MCC." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The delay in Phase 1 was primarily due to two back-to-back abnormal monsoons and licensing work.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "The delay in Phase 1 was, primarily due to two reasons, two back-to-back abnormal monsoons, and, certain licensing work, read with, say, regulatory approvals that was required, being, project treated as, greenfield." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Debt is being paid down - interest cost should keep falling.
A capex build-up is underway, pointing to future capacity.
opportunities.evidence: CWIP 102 Cr -> 135 Cr (32.4%) as of Sep 2026

opportunities.point: Sales are outgrowing costs - operating leverage should widen margins.
The price embeds less growth than the company has actually delivered.
opportunities.evidence: Reverse DCF implies 12.3% earnings growth vs 54% delivered over 5 years

opportunities.point: P/B is cheaper than the sector median.
Management stated that the current MCC demand outlook is good based on existing orders.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Sir, what you are having as of now, should be read with the intimation that what you have informed to the exchanges." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The company has roughly 4,000 metric tons of orders on hand.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Taking into account, say, domestic and export market, we have roughly around, 4,000 metric tons orders on hand with us." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: Profit is growing while operating cash flow is shrinking - an earnings-quality gap.
threats.evidence: Net profit 44 -> 57 Cr (TTM) but operating cash flow 25 Cr (Mar 2025) -> 19 Cr (Mar 2026)

threats.point: Promoter selling is a warning about insider conviction.
The stock has drawn down sharply in the past.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
External factors resulted in a delay in the commercialization of products.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Yes, sir, there were certain external factors which has, resulted, into delay in the commercialization of product" (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: The implementation schedule for Unit-III was re-aligned due to two consecutive abnormal monsoon seasons impacting on-site execution activities.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Two consecutive abnormal monsoon seasons impacting on-site execution activities" (concall ppt - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: Extended liaisoning timelines for obtaining required regulatory approvals also caused the implementation schedule re-alignment.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Extended liaisoning timelines for obtaining the required regulatory approvals" (concall ppt - 2026-05-01)
